characters.name: Sal (Salanar, in Kael Orendis's body)
characters.description: Male human (Kael's body), 39, 6'1, 204 lb, hazel eyes on the sheet (one eye is 'something darker' in the backstory), long black hair, pale; faith Ilmater
characters.backstory_full: The man who calls himself Sal was born Salanar, a Life Domain Cleric of Ilmater among the Vel'tharin, a reclusive healer commune in the Alimir foothills of Calimshan. When his partner Merith died slowly from a wasting sickness he couldn't cure, grief led him to void stones: black crystals that erase pain, and eventually, people. Convinced he was ending suffering, Salanar used the stones to unmake nearly his entire culture in an event survivors call the Great Erasure. The Vel'tharin's oral histories, their burden songs, their people, gone. A paladin named Kael Orendis led the surviving few to confront him. In desperation, Salanar forced his soul into Kael's body. But instead of a clean takeover, he lived Kael's entire life through his memories, birth to present, every joy, every prayer, every ordinary act of love. By the time he reached the present, decades of goodness had shattered his conviction. He hadn't ended suffering. He'd ended joy. Now calling himself Sal, he's spent two years in Kael's body, carrying Kael's oath and Kael's mission: finding Lysa, Kael's niece, a girl taken by Calishite slavers six months before the Erasure. She's the last living person Kael loved, and saving her is Sal's only thread to redemption. He wears his last void stone on a cord around his neck, not to use, but to resist. Two years clean. Some days that feels like nothing. He hears two voices. One warm and sorrowful, one cold and rational. He calls them Ilmater and the Unmaker. He doesn't know if either is real. He answers them anyway. A kindly old cleric named Brother Aldric serves as his sponsor, treating the void stone addiction like any other dependency. Aldric has no idea what Sal actually did. His advice is mundane, earnest, and accidentally profound. One of Sal's eyes is warm and human. The other is something darker. He doesn't explain why.

characters.name: TJ Star

traits.personality: I spend money freely and live life to the fullest, knowing that tomorrow I might die. I expect danger around every corner.
traits.ideal: I'm a monster that destroys other monsters, and anything else that gets in my way.
traits.bond: My torment drove away the person I love. I strive to win back the love I've lost. There's evil in me, I can feel it. It must never be set free.
traits.flaw: I have an addiction. I assume the worst in people.
